answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the pearl release is logged with every signature, the opal audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the dune graph and each risks its bond. That is 36 dollars per alias.
